description: Overhaul admin/avisos.php to support 'Por grupo' destination, and send the actual aviso title in push notifications instead of the generic message. Also overhaul api/obtener_avisos.php and api/marcar_leido.php to use the new avisos_leidos table and support group-based filtering.
steps: ADMIN/AVISOS.PHP - Add 'Por grupo' option: 1) At the top of the file (after conexion.php require), query distinct groups: SELECT DISTINCT grupo FROM alumnos WHERE grupo IS NOT NULL AND grupo != '' ORDER BY grupo. 2) In the destinatario select, add a third option 'grupo' with text 'Por grupo'. 3) Add a new hidden-by-default select element (id='select-grupo') populated with the groups from the query. 4) Update the toggleMatricula() JS function to show/hide both the matricula input and the grupo select depending on the selected value. Rename function to toggleDestinatario(). 5) Update the form submit JS to handle the grupo case: create hidden input with value 'grupo:' + selected grupo value.

ADMIN/AVISOS.PHP - Server-side validation for grupo: In the POST handler, after checking for 'todos' and matricula pattern, add an elseif for when destinatario starts with 'grupo:'. Extract the group name, validate it exists in alumnos table (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alumnos WHERE grupo = :grupo). If valid, keep the destinatario as 'grupo:GROUPNAME'.

ADMIN/AVISOS.PHP - Push notifications for grupo: When destinatario starts with 'grupo:', query tokens from dispositivos_padres WHERE matricula_alumno IN (SELECT matricula FROM alumnos WHERE grupo = :grupo). Loop and send push to each token.
ADMIN/AVISOS.PHP - Change push message: Replace the generic 'Tienes un nuevo aviso, revisa tu bandeja.' with the actual $titulo value when calling enviarAlertaFirebase().
ADMIN/AVISOS.PHP - Display grupo in the avisos table: In the destinatario column rendering, add a case for when destinatario starts with 'grupo:' showing a purple badge with the group name.

API/OBTENER_AVISOS.PHP - Rewrite query to: 1) JOIN with alumnos to get the student's grupo. 2) LEFT JOIN with avisos_leidos to check read status per user. 3) Filter: WHERE avisos_leidos.id IS NULL AND (destinatario = 'todos' OR destinatario = :matricula OR destinatario = CONCAT('grupo:', alumnos.grupo)). 4) Remove the 'leido = 0' condition since we now track reads via avisos_leidos.

API/MARCAR_LEIDO.PHP - Replace UPDATE avisos SET leido=1 with INSERT INTO avisos_leidos (id_aviso, matricula_alumno) VALUES (:id_aviso, :matricula) with IGNORE or ON DUPLICATE KEY to handle double-clicks. Keep the authorization check that verifies the aviso belongs to the user (destinatario check must now also include grupo-based matching via JOIN with alumnos).
acceptance_criteria: admin/avisos.php shows three options: Todos, Matricula especifica, Por grupo
Selecting 'Por grupo' shows a select with existing groups from DB
Saving a group aviso stores destinatario as 'grupo:X-Y' format
Push notifications are sent to all devices of students in that group
Push message contains the actual aviso title, not a generic message
api/obtener_avisos.php returns avisos not yet read by the current user (using avisos_leidos table)
api/obtener_avisos.php includes avisos targeted to the user's grupo
api/marcar_leido.php inserts into avisos_leidos instead of updating avisos.leido
All PHP files pass php -l syntax check
findings: All three files pass php -l. str_starts_with() used (requires PHP 8.0+). The avisos table still has the legacy 'leido' column which is displayed in the admin table but no longer updated by the API. Future cleanup could remove that column or repurpose it.
